name: What costs are involved when searching for and acquiring a replacement property in a 1031 exchange?

mainEntity.name: What costs are involved when searching for and acquiring a replacement property in a 1031 exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs for a replacement property search and acquisition are similar to a standard real estate purchase, including appraisal fees, inspection costs, title insurance, and closing costs. Additionally, there may be fees for a Qualified Intermediary (QI), which is a mandatory preparation step to facilitate the exchange. These costs should be factored into your investment strategy to avoid unexpected expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs include standard closing fees, appraisal, inspection, title insurance, and Qualified Intermediary fees for a 1031 exchange.
